name: Three-phase bridge rectifier
summary: A three-phase bridge rectifier converts a documented three-phase AC input into a DC output.
description: A three-phase bridge rectifier converts a documented three-phase AC input into a DC output. Its input phase terminals and DC polarity must be identifiable.
readingNotes: Check the rectifier's output and any smoothing network as separate circuit elements.

distinction: Three-phase rectification differs from a single-phase bridge connection.
